title: bheka.telemetry.batch.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-ingest when it has persisted a batch of telemetry events from an agent into ClickHouse. Stream: TELEMETRY. Consumers: bheka-policy (rule evaluation trigger). This event carries only ClickHouse row identifiers — no event content — consistent with the tier-boundary rule in 008_DATA_MODEL section 4. Retention: 7 days (short-lived trigger signal; the durable record is in ClickHouse with 90-180 day TTL per table).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which bheka-ingest completed the batch write.

agent_id.description: UUIDv7 of the agent that produced this batch.

tier.description: Visibility tier of the events in this batch (CANON section 4). All events in a single batch share the same tier.

clickhouse_row_ids.description: ClickHouse row identifiers for each event in this batch. bheka-policy uses these to locate events during rule evaluation. No event content is included here (008_DATA_MODEL section 4, tier-boundary rule).

event_count.description: Number of events in this batch. Must equal clickhouse_row_ids.length.
